name: docker-client
//version: The product's single source of truth for the running version: the client reads it at build time (client/app-version.ts) and displays it in the About notice. The client and server workspaces stay at 0.0.0 on purpose — see their own note.
author: Christian Mariani
//start: The single command that builds and serves the whole application on one port. The order and the && are load-bearing, not tidiness: build runs the client before the server because the server process serves the client's output from client/dist, and a failed link stops the chain, so a broken build never leaves the previous build running as if the command had worked. serve runs the built server and rebuilds nothing, so a restart costs no build time. dev:client and dev:server are the separate two-process development flow and are no part of this chain.

scripts.start: npm run build && npm run serve
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
